rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a strong, persistent attachment to a subject, activity, or idea.

example.english: My obsession with tea has left teaware all over the house.
example.traditional: 我對研究茶嘅執著，搞到屋企周圍都係茶具。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 jin4 gau3 caa4 ge3 zap1 zoek6 gaau2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 caa4 geoi6

rows.note: Use this when the interest feels addictive, especially for a hobby or activity.

example.english: I’ve developed an obsession with binge-watching dramas, so I turn on the TV as soon as I finish work.
example.traditional: 我近排有煲劇癮，一收工就開電視。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan6 paai2 jau5 bou1 kek6 jan5 jat1 sau1 gung1 zau6 hoi1 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this for a particular recurring idea or personal fixation that someone cannot let go of.

example.english: Their obsession with that lawsuit still has not faded after several years.
example.traditional: 佢對嗰場官司嘅執念，幾年喇都仲未放低。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 go2 coeng4 gun1 si1 ge3 zap1 nim6 gei2 nin4 laa3 dou1 zung6 mei6 fong3 dai1
